The most underrated city in Europe? Lyon 🇫🇷
We spent a few incredible days at the newly opened @courdesloges with @radissoncollection - a Renaissance landmark turned boutique hotel in the heart of Vieux Lyon.

Here’s your ultimate guide to Lyon ⬇️

📸 What to do:
- Get lost in the hidden traboules - secret passageways between courtyards unique to Lyon
- Ride the funicular to Fourvière Basilica for panoramic views
- Visit the Roman Theatre and ancient ruins on Fourvière Hill
- Unwind in the botanical gardens of Parc de la Tête d’Or
- Explore the Musée des Confluences - where architecture, science and art meet
- Walk along the Saône river and cross the Passerelle du Palais de Justice
- Visit the Musée des Beaux-Arts and Musée Lumière
- Discover Lyon’s silk-making tradition through artisan workshops
- Take a sunset river cruise for a magical view of the city

🍴 Where to eat & drink:
- Have dinner at Les Loges – an unforgettable fine dining experience at @courdesloges 
- Try local dishes at a traditional bouchon 
- Stop for coffee and pastries in the Presqu’île district
- Visit Les Halles Paul Bocuse - a covered food market filled with gourmet local products
- Discover wine bars and cocktail spots in the vibrant Croix-Rousse district

Lyon is where history meets gastronomy - elegant, walkable, and full of surprises. ✨ 

Save this for your next trip to France! 😍

Day 3: Cádiz 🚗 Drive to Cádiz - One of the oldest cities in Europe. 🌊 Walk along La Caleta beach - A scenic stretch framed by historic fortresses. 🏛️ Climb Torre Tavira - For views over the rooftops of the old town. 🍤 Dinner by the sea - Cádiz is famous for fresh seafood. Day 4: Ronda & Zahara de la Sierra 🪨 Stop in Zahara de la Sierra - A picturesque white village overlooking a turquoise reservoir. 🌉 Continue to Ronda - A dramatic towns perched above a deep gorge. 📸 Admire Puente Nuevo - The iconic bridge connecting the old and new town.
